## Outcome

Describe the user problem and resulting behavior. Link the related issue if there is one.

## Changes

Name the affected skills, references, documentation or package tooling. Explain any source or client-support boundary that changes.

## Verification

List the checks run and their results. For an instruction change, describe the task and expected behavioral difference. Distinguish offline package checks from observed client or model behavior.

## Limits

State any unverified behavior or remaining work. Confirm generated copies are current when their sources changed, and remove private data and disposable scratch from the contribution.
